description: Uploads a file attachment to the specified incident. Supports both multipart file upload and upload-ID-based attachment. The operation is idempotent.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the incident to attach the file to. Use the id from the List or Show Incidents response.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description:
Whether or not Configurable validations from the Incident/Injury Configurable Field Set should be run (default: false).
See (https://developers.procore.com/reference/configurable-field-sets#list-pr...

id.description: Unique identifier for this incident attachment. Use as a reference when managing attachments on an action.

url.description: Download URL for the full-size attachment file.

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a large thumbnail preview of the attachment. Null if no preview is available.

name.description: Original filename of the uploaded attachment, including file extension.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment file (e.g. application/pdf, image/jpeg).

viewable_document_id.description: Identifier of the associated viewable document for in-browser rendering. Null if the attachment has not been converted for viewing.

viewable.description: Indicates whether the attachment can be viewed in-browser. True if the file type supports viewing or a viewable document has been generated.

can_be_viewed.description: Indicates whether the attachment has finished processing and is ready for in-browser viewing.

attachment.description: Binary file to upload as an incident attachment. Submit the entire request as multipart/form-data content type.
